They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. message.content:
Pebble Spring was a Leshy.
They set foot in a city.
The city looked strange to them.
The paved ground felt smooth.
The bridges looked intricate.
The houses seemed magical.
They loved stone walls.
They loved warm shelters.
They wanted to understand family stories.
They found a local mason.
The mason showed them a workshop.
Pebble Spring held their crafted staff.
A touch of arcane magic sparkled.
The stones moved slowly.
The beams aligned neatly.
The roof took shape.
Pebble Spring learned careful measurement.
Pebble Spring learned patient labor.
Pebble Spring learned humility.
Pebble Spring loved the craft.
Pebble Spring helped build a small cottage.
The cottage had a stone hearth.
The cottage welcomed the first rain.
Although Pebble Spring had arrived in the city with only a crafted staff, they quickly admired every street, every bridge, every courtyard, every quiet alley, and every warm house, and their new feelings became spotty today.
